collection.title: Vauxhall Zafira 1998 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Zafira 1998 to 2005 model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and a 22" on the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Zafira which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
